blocks.text: A2-11 · Comparative and superlative
Lesson overview

The largest city is: to compare Arabic, it uses only one scheme. afʿal ( ⁧أَفْعَل⁩ ), which gives together comparative and superlative. From ⁧كَبِير⁩ Large ⁧أَكْبَر⁩ • Larger / Largest; from ⁧رَخِيص⁩ Economic ⁧أَرْخَص⁩ . When the adjective doesn't enter the scheme, you use it. ⁧أَكْثَر⁩ Other ⁧أَقَلّ⁩ The least is followed by a name to the accusative. The female form of the superlative, fuʿlā ( ⁧كُبْرَى⁩ , ⁧عُلْيَا⁩ , ⁧أُولَى⁩ ), meets above all in fixed names of politics and geography: here you learn to recognize it. The context is the comparison between cities, prices and hotels, in view of Luca's trip to Cairo. A week.

Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. form comparative afʿal by the adjectives of three radicals, including double roots ( ⁧أَقَلّ⁩ ), defective ( ⁧أَغْلَى⁩ ) e
with hamza ( ⁧أَهْدَأ⁩ );
2. compare with ⁧مِنْ⁩ , also with pronouns ( ⁧أَكْبَرُ مِنِّي⁩ ), and grade with ⁧بِكَثِيرٍ⁩ and ⁧قَلِيلًا⁩ ;
3. use ⁧أَكْثَرُ⁩ / ⁧أَقَلُّ⁩ + accusative when the adjective does not have the form afʿal ( ⁧أَكْثَرُ ازْدِحَامًا⁩ );
4. expressing the superlative in three ways ( ⁧أَكْبَرُ مَدِينَةٍ⁩ , ⁧أَكْبَرُ المُدُنِ⁩ , ⁧المَدِينَةُ الكُبْرَى⁩ );
5. recognizing female fuʿlā in fixed names ( ⁧القَاهِرَةُ الكُبْرَى⁩ , ⁧المَحْكَمَةُ العُلْيَا⁩ , ⁧الشَّرْقُ الأَوْسَطُ⁩ );
6. compare two cities and choose from several offers (hotels, products).

2. The scheme afʿal
The three radicals of the adjective are placed in the a-C1C2a-C3 scheme ( ⁧أَفْعَل⁩ ): ⁧كَبِير⁩ ( ⁧ك ب ر⁩ ) → ⁧أَكْبَر⁩ .
⁧كَثِير⁩ very ⁧ضَيِّقأَكْثَر⁩ tight ⁧أَضْيَق⁩
Double root (second and third equal radical): the two consonants join with the shadda.
⁧خَفِيف⁩ Light ( ⁧خ ف ف⁩ ) ⁧أَخَفّ⁩ aḫaff
Defective and adjective roots in -iyy: the end is -ā, written ⁧ى⁩ .
⁧ذَكِيّ⁩ Intelligent ( ⁧ذ ك ي⁩ ) ⁧أَذْكَى⁩ aḏkā

Final Hamza : ⁧هَادِئ⁩ → ⁧أَهْدَأ⁩ , ⁧بَطِيء⁩ → ⁧أَبْطَأ⁩ . Good and bad: ⁧جَيِّد⁩ • good • has as comparative ⁧أَفْضَل⁩ (more used) or ⁧أَحْسَن⁩ The following paragraph is added: ⁧سَيِّئ⁩ • bad • ago ⁧أَسْوَأ⁩ Worse. The way it's used. Comparative + ⁧مِنْ⁩ Of a cylinder capacity exceeding 1000 cm3

blocks.text: ⁧أُخْتِي أَكْبَرُ مِنِّي بِسَنَتَيْنِ.⁩ My sister is two years older than me.
Four rules:
1. afʿal does not agree when followed by ⁧مِنْ⁩ : ⁧هُوَ أَكْبَرُ⁩ , ⁧هِيَ أَكْبَرُ⁩ , ⁧هُمْ أَكْبَرُ⁩ .
2. It is diptototo (A2-08): nothing tanwīn, and the genitive takes -a. In pause reading you can't hear it.
3. After an indefinite name afʿal it works as an adjective, more... ⁧أُرِيدُ غُرْفَةً أَهْدَأَ⁩ I want a more room
Quiet, ⁧فُنْدُقٌ أَرْخَصُ⁩ It's a cheaper hotel.
4. The difference is expressed by ⁧بِـ⁩ : ⁧أَكْبَرُ بِسَنَتَيْنِ⁩ • greater than two years • ⁧أَغْلَى بِعَشَرَةِ يُورُو⁩ More expensive than ten
Euro-Men.
3. ⁧أَكْثَر⁩ and ⁧أَقَلّ⁩ + accusative

Many adjectives cannot enter the scheme afʿal: the parties ( ⁧مُزْدَحِم⁩ , ⁧مُمْتِع⁩ , ⁧مُرِيح⁩ ), the adjectives in -ī ( ⁧اِقْتِصَادِيّ⁩ ), those with more than three radicals and colors, which already have the shape afʿal. In such cases it is used ⁧أَكْثَرُ⁩ ... more than or ⁧أَقَلُّ⁩ The name of the indeterminate accused person (named after the name of the accused person) shall be followed by the following: tamyīz, "specification" (s):

⁧أَقَلّ⁩ is the normal way of saying ⁧القِطَارُ أَقَلُّ تَكْلِفَةً مِنَ الطَّائِرَةِ⁩ The train costs less than the plane. When the adjective has an opposite, one prefers that: instead of less distant, it is said ⁧أَقْرَب⁩ Closer. ⁧أَكْثَرُ مِنْ⁩ by numbers means more than ⁧أَكْثَرُ مِنْ مِلْيُونٍ⁩ More than one million ⁧أَقَلُّ مِنْ سَاعَةٍ⁩ It shall be less than one hour. With verbs ⁧أَكْثَرَ⁩ and ⁧أَقَلَّ⁩ are adverbs (accusative): ⁧يَعْمَلُ أَكْثَرَ مِنِّي⁩ "Works more than me" ⁧يَأْكُلُ أَقَلَّ⁩ It eats less.
4. The Superlative
The same afʿal also gives superlative, in three buildings.
Article + afʿal after the name (adjective) ⁧المَدِينَةُ الكُبْرَى⁩ the largest city

The first is the most frequent. afʿal does not agree: ⁧أَجْمَلُ بِنْتٍ⁩ The most beautiful girl... ⁧أَهَمُّ شَيْءٍ⁩ The most important thing is. The construction is determined even if the second name is indefinite: it translates with the article. The second is used for one of the... ⁧مِنْ⁩ : ⁧مِنْ أَقْدَمِ الآثَارِ فِي العَالَمِ⁩ It is one of the oldest monuments in the world. and with the pronouns: ⁧أَصْغَرُهُمْ⁩ The youngest of them. ⁧أَفْضَلُكُمْ⁩ It's the best of you. The third is a normal adjective with the article, and agrees: ⁧الأَخُ الأَكْبَرُ⁩ • the elder brother • ⁧الأُخْتُ الكُبْرَى⁩ • the older sister (section) 5). It is mainly used for ...more/less in the family and in the fixed names. Alone with the article afʿal means "the most..." the best... ⁧هٰذَا هُوَ الأَفْضَلُ⁩ This is the best of all. ⁧تَخْتَارِينَ الأَغْلَى⁩ Choose the most expensive of them.
5. The Female fuʿlā (recognize)
When afʿal is adjective with the article and the name is feminine, takes the scheme fuʿlā ( ⁧فُعْلَى⁩ ):

⁧المَحْكَمَةُ العُلْيَا⁩ The Supreme Court ⁧الدِّرَاسَاتُ العُلْيَا⁩ Post-graduate studies
⁧الحَدُّ الأَدْنَى⁩ The minimum value of the product shall be: ⁧الدُّنْيَا⁩ The world (land)
⁧أَمْرِيكَا الوُسْطَى⁩ Central America ⁧الشَّرْقُ الأَوْسَطُ⁩ The Middle East (m.)
⁧الحَرْبُ العَالَمِيَّةُ الأُولَى⁩ The First World War

Taste and choices. ⁧يُعْجِبُنِي⁩ I like it, it has the thing that I like: ⁧تُعْجِبُنِي هٰذِهِ المَدِينَةُ⁩ I like this city. (female verb because ⁧مَدِينَة⁩ is female), ⁧أَعْجَبَنِي الفُنْدُقُ⁩ I liked the hotel. To prefer use ⁧أُفَضِّلُ⁩ ( A1): ⁧أُفَضِّلُ القِطَارَ عَلَى الطَّائِرَةِ⁩ I prefer the train to the plane ( ⁧عَلَى⁩ It introduces the second term).
7. Pronunciation

The initial hamza. ⁧أَكْبَر⁩ It starts with a glottis stroke: ʾak-bar. After a word, in the sentence, the hamza remains: ⁧هِيَ أَكْبَرُ⁩ hiya ʾakbar (not "hiyakbar") Double roots. In aqall, ahamm, aḫaff the final consonant is double: it is held a moment also in pause. akbar / kubrā. The male has the initial a and the accent on the first syllable (ák-bar); the female has the u and the ā long final (kub-rā). Similarly aʿlā / ʿul-yā, awsaṭ / wus-ṭā. aġlā, aqwā. The -ā final is long even if written ⁧ى⁩ : don't sayaġla».

⁧مِيلَانُو وَالقَاهِرَةُ⁩

⁧بَعْدَ شَهْرَيْنِ سَأُسَافِرُ إِلَى القَاهِرَةِ لِأَوَّلِ مَرَّةٍ. سَأَلْتُ سَلْمَى عَنْ مَدِينَتِهَا، وَكَتَبْتُ هٰذِهِ المُقَارَنَةَ. القَاهِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ مِيلَانُو بِكَثِيرٍ. يَعِيشُ فِي مِيلَانُو أَقَلُّ مِنْ مِلْيُونٍ وَنِصْفٍ، وَفِي القَاهِرَةِ الكُبْرَى أَكْثَرُ مِنْ⁩

⁧مِيلَانُو أَصْغَرُ، لٰكِنَّهَا أَهَمُّ مَدِينَةٍ فِي الاِقْتِصَادِ الإِيطَالِيِّ.⁩ .« ⁧أَكْثَرُ ازْدِحَامًا مِنْ شَوَارِعِ رُومَا!⁩
